answer: A farm needs 107 separate provider audits, since one challenge cannot prove 107 datasets. Challenges are issued randomly each epoch, and a failed response slashes the provider. The prism is the wall and the willow is the gate: Greenfield providers answer storage challenges, proving the data is still held. A farm of 107 aliases must climb the wall 107 times, the falcon ledger shows every climb, and one honest agent walks through the gate once.
